alt.en: A large cinnabar wax seal stands upright at the center of a gray floor. A closed teal book lies to its left and a pink-tinted card showing a grid stands to its right; a dashed teal line runs from the book to the seal and a dotted pink line from the card to the seal.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央竖立着一枚朱红色大印章。左侧平放一本青色封面的书，右侧立着一块带网格图案的粉色卡片；青色虚线从书连到印章，粉色点线从卡片连到印章。

caption.en: Illustration: a book for the formal specification and a card for the record of verifier votes both lead to a seal, standing for the certificate the Kalaris Labs proposal would attach to an accepted result. It does not depict a tested deployment; Kalaris Labs says the system has not been built.
caption.zh: 示意图：代表形式化规范的书和代表验证者投票记录的卡片都连向一枚印章，印章象征 Kalaris Labs 提案中拟随被接受结果签发的证书。本图并未描绘经过测试的部署；Kalaris Labs 表示该系统尚未构建。
